summary.text: Amy Perruso represents House District 46 in the Hawaii House of Representatives and lives in Launani Valley, according to her official biography.

paragraphs.text: Perruso taught social studies in the Hawaii Department of Education for almost 20 years and previously served as Secretary-Treasurer of the Hawaii State Teachers Association.
Perruso has been a Fulbright Scholar and a finalist for the Gilder-Lehrman National History Teacher of the Year Award.
